reference.text: Let us now note what is least dissimilar in these heads—namely, the two most important organs, the eye and the ear.

underlines.text: produce one picture and not two to the brain; the peculiar position of the whale’s eyes

reference.text: Now, from this peculiar sideway position of the whale’s eyes, it is plain that he can never see an object which is exactly ahead, no more than he can one exactly astern.

underlines.text: surround each by a circle of profound darkness; then

reference.text: The whale, therefore, must see one distinct picture on this side, and another distinct picture on that side; while all between must be profound darkness and nothingness to him.
